subject: Demo: GitHub integration & Open source connector
messages:
From: Maria Gonzales <maria@openlib.dev>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Interested in Redwood + GitHub integration - demo request

Hey Alex -

I signed up via the self-serve flow this morning (thanks for the quick onboarding flow!). We're evaluating Redwood for an integration with our CI and GitHub Actions workflows and would love a short demo to walk through:

- How Redwood can be triggered from GitHub Actions
- Examples of model routing for public vs. private repos
- Authentication/KMS options for private environments

Could we schedule a 30-minute demo next week? I'm in PDT and generally free Tues/Wed afternoons. I attached a short one-page with our repo layout.

Thanks,
Maria Gonzales
SRE, OpenLib

Attachment: openlib-repo-overview.pdf (1 page)

Hi Maria - great to meet you and glad the signup went smoothly. Happy to run a short demo focused on GitHub Actions + private repo workflows.

I have the following slots open next week (PDT):
- Tue 6/16 2:00pm - 2:30pm
- Tue 6/16 4:00pm - 4:30pm
- Wed 6/17 3:00pm - 3:30pm

If none of those work, here's my Calendly: https://calendly.com/alex-redwood/30min

I'll loop in Camila (solutions engineer) on the invite so she can prep examples for GitHub Actions triggers and a quick architecture sketch.

Quick ask for prep: could you share the public repo link (or a trimmed private one we can use) and confirm if you're evaluating Hosted API or Private deployment?

Cheers,
Alex Martinez

alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
From: Maria Gonzales <maria@openlib.dev>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interested in Redwood + GitHub integration - demo request

Thanks Alex - Tue 6/16 at 4pm works for us.

Re: repo - our public mirror is https://github.com/openlib/openlib-repo. We're primarily evaluating Hosted API to start (want to test routing/latency) but will need Private later for certain repos. Also, quick question for the demo: do you have examples of a GitHub Action that posts a PR comment with a model summary? Trying to scope the level of effort.

-Maria

Perfect - I've booked Tue 6/16 4:00pm PDT. Camila, looping you in to prep: recommended agenda below and a quick sample GitHub Action we can walk through.

Agenda (30m):
- 5m: intros & goals
- 10m: demo - trigger from GitHub Actions, model routing, auth options
- 10m: review architecture options (Hosted -> Private) + next steps
- 5m: Q/A and immediate POC checklist

Sample Action (high-level):
- Action checks PR comments -> runs inference on changed files -> posts summary comment using Redwood API with short-lived key

Maria - can you confirm attendees and whether you'll need an NDA before the demo? I'll send the calendar invite with conference link and attach the sample action + one-pager.

Thanks,
Alex

- We typically recommend using a short-lived token issued by your CI runner and a scoped Redwood API key for PR comment flows
- If you need on-prem/Private later, we'll show the KMS integration options and a migration path
